description: Awarding of the contract for the Construction Project of the Faculty of Medicine of the Uva Wellassa University of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2025-06-09, granted approval to initiate procurement activities for design, construction, and commissioning related to the first phase of the construction of the Faculty of Medicine of the Uva Wellassa University of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, bids were invited under the national competitive bidding method and six bids were received for the same. The proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, to award the contract for the Construction Project of the Faculty of Medicine of the Uva Wellassa University of Sri Lanka to M/s Sathutu Builders (Pvt) Ltd., for a sum of Rs. 1,699.81 million (excluding taxes), based on the recommendation of the High Level Procurement Committee after evaluating the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.
